item.tib: dug phyung rig 'dzin tshan khrus dkar bgegs gta' chen
item.note: this text contains three different rituals: pp. 19-22v3 is a 'black purifying ritual' (bsang nag) or 'extraction of poison' (dug phyung). pp. 22v3-27r1 is a 'water purifying ritual' (tshan khrus) taught by sprul-sku rig-'dzin chen-po (i.e. stong-rgyung mthu-chen); see 22v3. pp. 27r1-33r3 is a white purifying ritual (lha bsang dkar po), also taught by sprul-sku rig-'dzin chen-po (see p. 27r2). the ritual of this text should always be performed at the beginning of inner tantra rituals, hence its inclusion here.
